summary: Frontend-only UX/redesign test of Tienda de Skins (/tienda-skins). Authenticated via POST /api/auth/demo, stored token under localStorage 'primal_token', and validated all requested flows: header, Featured Hero banner, catalog-count (15 skins), grid renders 15 GalleryCards, search filter, dino/type/sort shadcn Selects, view toggle (grid<->list), modal open via hero-buy-btn and via card click, modal close, and mobile responsiveness at 390x844 (no horizontal overflow). All flows passed.
critical_code_review_comments: TiendaSkins.jsx WebSocket effect uses shopWsUrl() without try/catch on constructor failure being isolated; if ws creation fails it silently swallows — currently acceptable but consider logging in dev.
SkinDetailModal.jsx: max-h-[85vh] with overflow-y-auto on info column is fine; ensure DialogContent parent doesn't clip on very small heights.
featured useMemo sorts entire items array by rarity/price on every items change — OK for 15 items, watch scaling.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tienda-skins redesign fully verified on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844. Auth token key is 'primal_token'. Hero banner picks highest-rarity destacado skin (Obsidian legendary tyrannosaurus_rex). Modal shows buy-btn for unowned skins; equip-btn/skin-equipped-btn paths exist for owned. Stripe checkout not exercised per instructions.
